description: Two filenames that canonicalize to the SAME locale, which the loader treats as a conflict rather than a merge or a last-wins overwrite. he and iw both map to Locale.forLanguageTag('iw') == Locale.forLanguageTag('he'), so the containsKey guard at LocalizedStringLoader.java:1265-1267 throws LocalizedStringLoadingException. Written as rawFiles because the two names are FILENAMES, not two locale-tagged catalogs. loadOnly because the load is deliberately unloadable.
